newsitem.title: USA: Marriott to buy $1.3 bln of hotels in '97.
newsitem.headline: Marriott to buy $1.3 bln of hotels in '97.

text.p: Host Marriott Corp said Thursday it acquired about $850 million in properties in the first quarter and was raising its original 1997 acquisition goal of $1.0 billion to $1.3 billion.

The company disclosed it raised its acquisition target after it said Thursday it acquired the New York Marriott Financial Center Hotel, a property it expects will generate $11.5 million in earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA).

The company purchased the mortgage on the 504-room New York hotel from a financial institution for approximately $101 million in December. By acquiring it at about 63 percent of replacement cost during a strong lodging market, it was confident it would realize outstanding results.
The company also expected significant savings in hotel operations by consolidating management of the hotel with a second one it owns in lower Manhattan.

Host Marriott is a real estate company that currently owns or holds controlling interests in 84 upscale and luxury full service hotel properties operated primarily under the Marriott and Ritz-Carlton brand names.
